rule: A swing alert is recorded when the observed mid-price of a tracked market differs from the previous observation of the same market by >= $0.10 in either direction.
scoreDisclosure: The filtered feed is ranked by a 0-100 project heuristic (move size, crossable depth, spread, 24h volume, freshness). It is not a forecast, not return on investment, and not Kalshi data.
note: Empty by design at first publication. A swing alert requires two observations of the same market at different times; the authoring sandbox cannot reach the Kalshi demo API, so no second observation exists yet. Nothing is seeded here: the page states that it is waiting for the first cycle rather than showing a stand-in row.
expectedFirstRun: The first run of .github/workflows/collect-node.yml appends the first genuine two-observation swings.
